$note: The protection `main` is supposed to have. GitHub does not read this file — nothing can, because
branch protection is settings rather than content. What it does is make the intent reviewable:
`node .github/scripts/branch-protection.mjs` prints the drift between this and reality and exits 1,
`--apply` writes this file to GitHub, and `--selftest` checks the comparison logic without a token.
$decided: The contexts are the check names GitHub ACTUALLY reported on recent merged pull requests, not names
read out of the workflows: a required check that never reports blocks every pull request forever.
